Dot notation parsing broken for table-valued functions in CROSS/OUTER APPLY

When parsing SQL with CROSS APPLY or OUTER APPLY that includes table-valued functions with dot notation (like `a.b.tvfTest`), the parser fails to handle the dotted function names correctly.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import sqlglot

# This should parse correctly but doesn't
sql = "SELECT t.x, y.z FROM x OUTER APPLY a.b.tvfTest(t.x)y(z)"
parsed = sqlglot.parse_one(sql, dialect="tsql")
print(parsed)
```

The parser seems to have issues with dotted identifiers in the context of table-valued functions used with APPLY operations. This affects SQL Server T-SQL queries that use schema-qualified or database-qualified table-valued functions.
</issue>
